transient_control.method: Stereo-linked60ms lookahead minimum hold,6ms Gaussian gain smoothing; no hard clipping

sections.name: shared_question
sections.rationale: The same identifiable rhythm is heard in a warmer upper piano register.

sections.name: friend_answer
sections.rationale: A C-B-A answer and a short separate upper reply suggest a second presence.

sections.name: lifted_question
sections.rationale: The motif expands upward through G and F before it gently falls.

sections.name: friend_return
sections.rationale: The descending answer remains suspended on D/E so the loop remains open.
